title: Add model-adaptive prompting policy
measurement_note: Timing is estimated from the web-first intake, memory bootstrap, edits, generated map refresh, and validation milestones after the user request.

phases.label: Web-first intake
phases.bottleneck_notes: Checked self-consistency, Self-Refine, Reflexion, OpenAI reasoning, and Microsoft model-specific prompting sources.

phases.label: Memory and structure review
phases.bottleneck_notes: Reviewed AI usage gap profile, requirements baseline, operating docs, persistent instructions, workflow, prompt, memory bootstrap, router, and current history patterns.

phases.label: Rule and artifact implementation
phases.bottleneck_notes: The cross-cutting governance update touched config, requirements, specs, operating docs, prompts, memory, maps, research notes, and history.

phases.label: Verification
phases.bottleneck_notes: Initial JSON, config contract, memory bootstrap, docs audit, naming audit, structure audit, workspace map, and task board checks completed before final evaluator checks.

bottleneck_analysis.interpretation: The main time cost is maintaining consistency across durable governance surfaces rather than writing the rule itself.
improvement_candidates: Create a reusable governance-rule update checklist that enumerates config, requirements, specs, docs, workflows, prompts, memory, and history targets.
Consider a deterministic two-pass comparison helper if the model-adaptive strategy is used often.
